ENTERPRISE SPECIFICATION: Principal Systems Architect - Capital Markets Group.

SECTION 1: OVERVIEW & DIVISION MISSION
The Capital Markets Technology Organization orchestrates multi-asset settlement and regulatory risk monitoring across 38 global markets. We are seeking a Principal Systems Architect with extensive distributed architecture expertise to lead our core modernization.

SECTION 2: COMPREHENSIVE RESPONSIBILITIES
- Own the technical blueprint and reference architecture for real-time transaction processing.
- Partner with managing directors, chief risk officers, and enterprise security leads.
- Drive containerized workload orchestrations across hybrid AWS and on-premise Kubernetes clusters.
- Define multi-datacenter active-active disaster recovery standards.
- Oversee telemetry pipelines processing 250,000 telemetry metrics per second.

SECTION 3: MANDATORY TECHNICAL QUALIFICATIONS
- 10+ years professional experience in distributed systems architecture.
- Deep mastery of Java, Spring Boot, and enterprise microservices patterns.
- Proven track record implementing high-volume message streaming with Apache Kafka.
- Production leadership with cloud deployments on Amazon Web Services (AWS).
- Proven experience designing low-latency, fault-tolerant transaction networks.

SECTION 4: ENTERPRISE COMPLIANCE AND GOVERNANCE
- Adhere to SOC2 Type II, ISO 27001, and FINRA regulatory frameworks.
- Lead quarterly disaster recovery simulations and chaos engineering experiments.
- Mentor staff and principal engineers across 4 global engineering hubs.
